answer: An attester must stake 50% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. Because the knoll stake is held until the jetty settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the harbor audit lists each exposure. A farm running 82 keys thus forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
